claims.explanation: The batch requests eight independently answerable decisions; technical level and audience/takeaway are separate, and Q6 separately asks for view selection and a standout moment.
The HLD already requires both the normal delivery ending and the Wi-Fi-down alternate, so asking which endings to include was redundant.
At the selected engineering level, the design-established device-shadow-to-app read dependency must appear in topology. The app panel names a GET source, but no corresponding diagram edge exists.
“Now reads” asserts a current shadow-to-app read, but that operation has no lit hop at bedtime.

The explicitly authored 25% physical value at 1:10 AM is an intermediate state between conflicting anchors and ignores both elapsed idle drain and the raccoon clip. The direct-anchor exception does not permit this invented intermediate value.
The 1:00 AM heartbeat is authored as a new 25% report, independently implying an unstated zero-drain rate. Shadow and app represent the same report, so this is one scoring unit.

At the same step where the caption says nothing reaches the phone, the visible phone panel newly renders the animal event. The no-push state is correct, but the broader caption and visible update contradict each other.
The camera-side queue presents the clip as package-classified before the server-side classifier runs after reconnect.
There are eight independently answerable decisions: technical level; audience; takeaway; timing changes; endings; starting phone state; views to include/drop; and a moment to emphasize.
The HLD already requires both the normal delivery ending and the Wi-Fi-down alternate, so asking which endings to depict repeats supplied information.
The engineering diagram declares no device-shadow→app read edge, although the HLD establishes that dependency.
The caption explicitly claims a current device-page read, but the step lights only camera→router→event-ingest→device-shadow and no shadow→app read.

Between the conflicting 25% and 20% anchors, the story authors an intermediate physical value of 25% at 1:10 AM despite elapsed idle drain and the raccoon clip. The direct anchor jump exception does not permit this invented intermediate zero-drain value.

The newly authored 1:00 AM shadow/app report is 25%, an intermediate reported value that likewise depends on the unstated zero-drain hold. Shadow and app are the same report and therefore form one unit.
